tool_schemas.name: universal_scraper
tool_schemas.description: Submits a Universal scrape job for the provided url and returns an accepted job record for your workspace, including the persisted input parameters and the initial execution state; the job output is stored for later retrieval in the requested output_format (and parsed when parse_content=true). This endpoint does not page results; pagination_page and pagination_pages control how many pages the job will attempt to fetch as part of a single submission. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid (e.g., url not a string, unsupported enums, non-integer pagination values, or scheduled_at not date-time), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when credentials are missing or do not grant access to the workspace, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when your workspace has insufficient remaining usage to accept the job, and CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused with different parameters or when a scheduled_at time is not acceptable for scheduling.

parse_content.description: Whether to parse the response content into structured data when possible.

output_format.description: Desired output format for the job result.

user_agent_type.description: User agent profile used to fetch the target.

target_domain.description: Provider domain to target (e.g., a country TLD) when applicable.

geo.description: Geolocation hint for the request (provider-specific geo code/string).

locale.description: Locale/language hint for the request (provider-specific locale code/string).

pagination_page.description: Starting page index for paginated scraping.

pagination_pages.description: Number of pages to scrape for paginated requests.

priority.description: Optional scheduling priority for the job (higher typically runs sooner).

scheduled_at.description: Optional time to schedule the job execution.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key to deduplicate repeated submissions.

tool_schemas.name: google_search_scraper
tool_schemas.description: Submits a Google Search scrape job for the provided query and returns an accepted job record for your workspace, persisting the input parameters and initial state; results are stored for later retrieval in the requested output_format and can be parsed into structured SERP data when parse_content=true. This endpoint does not page responses; pagination_page and pagination_pages specify which SERP pages the job will fetch within a single job submission. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when query is missing/invalid or any parameter fails schema/enum checks (including scheduled_at formatting), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the API credentials are invalid or not permitted for the workspace, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when workspace limits prevent accepting a new job, and CONFLICT when an idempotency_key is replayed with differing inputs or when the requested schedule cannot be honored.

query.description: Search query to run on Google.

parse_content.description: Whether to parse SERP content into structured results.

output_format.description: Desired output format for the job result.

user_agent_type.description: User agent profile used to fetch Google results.

target_domain.description: Google domain to target (e.g., google.com, google.co.uk).

geo.description: Geolocation hint for localized results (provider-specific geo code/string).

locale.description: Locale/language hint for results (provider-specific locale code/string).

pagination_pages.description: Number of result pages to scrape.

priority.description: Optional scheduling priority for the job (higher typically runs sooner).

scheduled_at.description: Optional time to schedule the job execution.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key to deduplicate repeated submissions.

tool_schemas.name: amazon_search_scraper
tool_schemas.description: Submits an Amazon Search scrape job for the provided query and returns an accepted job record, storing the job inputs (including optional amazon_category_id, amazon_merchant_id, and amazon_currency) and the initial execution state; the job output is persisted for later retrieval in the requested output_format and can be parsed into structured listings when parse_content=true. This endpoint does not page responses; pagination_page and pagination_pages control which Amazon result pages are fetched as part of the job. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when query is missing/invalid, Amazon-specific fields are malformed, or any parameter fails schema/enum checks, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when credentials are missing/invalid or not authorized for the workspace, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when workspace usage limits would be exceeded by accepting the job, and CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused with different inputs or the requested scheduled_at cannot be scheduled.

query.description: Search query to run on Amazon.

parse_content.description: Whether to parse search results into structured product entries.

output_format.description: Desired output format for the job result.

user_agent_type.description: User agent profile used to fetch Amazon results.

target_domain.description: Amazon domain to target (e.g., amazon.com, amazon.co.uk).

geo.description: Geolocation hint for localized results (provider-specific geo code/string).

locale.description: Locale/language hint for results (provider-specific locale code/string).

pagination_pages.description: Number of result pages to scrape.

amazon_category_id.description: Amazon category/browse node identifier to scope the search.

amazon_merchant_id.description: Amazon merchant/seller identifier to scope the search.

amazon_currency.description: Currency code for pricing normalization (e.g., USD, EUR).

priority.description: Optional scheduling priority for the job (higher typically runs sooner).

scheduled_at.description: Optional time to schedule the job execution.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key to deduplicate repeated submissions.

tool_schemas.name: amazon_product_scraper
tool_schemas.description: Submits an Amazon Product scrape job for the provided amazon_asin and returns an accepted job record for your workspace, persisting inputs (including amazon_currency and amazon_auto_select_variant) and the initial execution state; the product page output is stored for later retrieval in the requested output_format and can be parsed into structured fields when parse_content=true. This endpoint does not page results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when amazon_asin is missing/invalid or when any parameter fails schema/enum checks (including scheduled_at), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when API credentials are invalid or lack workspace access, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when your workspace cannot accept additional usage, and CONFLICT when idempotency_key deduplication detects mismatched parameters for the same key or the requested schedule is not acceptable.

amazon_asin.description: Amazon ASIN of the product to scrape.

parse_content.description: Whether to parse the product page into structured fields.

output_format.description: Desired output format for the job result.

user_agent_type.description: User agent profile used to fetch the product page.

target_domain.description: Amazon domain to target (e.g., amazon.com, amazon.de).

geo.description: Geolocation hint for localized product availability/pricing (provider-specific geo code/string).

locale.description: Locale/language hint for the product page (provider-specific locale code/string).

amazon_currency.description: Currency code for pricing normalization (e.g., USD, EUR).

amazon_auto_select_variant.description: Whether to auto-select a product variant to obtain more accurate pricing data.

priority.description: Optional scheduling priority for the job (higher typically runs sooner).

scheduled_at.description: Optional time to schedule the job execution.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided key to deduplicate repeated submissions.

tool_schemas.name: get_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller context resolved from the presented API key, including the workspace, API key status, granted scopes, and current-period quota and usage; refuses requests with missing/invalid/revoked credentials or a non-active workspace.

api_key.description: Oxylabs API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: list_scrape_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists scrape jobs for the authenticated workspace with filtering and pagination; returns persisted inputs and current execution state for traceability; refuses requests with missing/invalid/revoked credentials or a non-active workspace.

api_key.description: Oxylabs API key used to authenticate the request.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

created_after.description: Return jobs created at or after this time.

created_before.description: Return jobs created at or before this time.

tool_schemas.name: get_scrape_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single scrape job by id for the authenticated workspace, including persisted input parameters and current lifecycle status; refuses access if the job is not in the caller workspace or the credentials/workspace are not active.

api_key.description: Oxylabs API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: update_scrape_job
tool_schemas.description: Updates a scrape job lifecycle state when permitted (e.g., cancel a queued/running job, or retry a failed job back to queued) and optionally adjusts scheduling/priority; refuses invalid transitions, attempts to retry beyond max_attempts, or updates for jobs outside the caller workspace.

api_key.description: Oxylabs API key used to authenticate the request.

status.description: Requested status transition. Use cancelled to stop a queued/running job; use queued to retry a failed job when attempt < max_attempts.

priority.description: Optional updated scheduling priority (higher typically runs sooner).

scheduled_at.description: Optional updated time to schedule the job execution (only while not finished).

tool_schemas.name: list_job_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored result parts for a scrape job (one per fetched page when pagination_pages > 1), including status and metadata; refuses access if the job is not in the caller workspace or the credentials/workspace are not active.

api_key.description: Oxylabs API key used to authenticate the request.

job_id.description: Scrape job id whose results should be listed.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of result parts to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_job_result
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored result part by id for the authenticated workspace; returns raw_body and/or parsed payload depending on output_format and parse_content, and returns nulled/redacted bodies when status is redacted or deleted; refuses access if the result/job is not in the caller workspace or the credentials/workspace are not active.

api_key.description: Oxylabs API key used to authenticate the request.

include_raw_body.description: Whether to include raw_body when available (may be null for redacted/deleted).

include_parsed.description: Whether to include parsed when available (null when parse_content=false or redacted/deleted).
